11B.
A resolution of the Cerritos City Council authorizing conveyance of property owned by the City of Cerritos to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency located at the southeast corner of 183rd Street and Carmenita Road, Cerritos, California 90703 (adjacent to APN 7023-007-903), measuring approximately ±0.05 acres total in area, for use in connection with the development of an 18-unit affordable senior housing project. A joint resolution of the Cerritos City Council and Cerritos Redevelopment Agency approving a report pursuant to California Health and Safety Code Section 33433 regarding the execution of a first amendment to the disposition and development agreement concerning conveyance of property owned by the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency located at the southeast corner of 183rd Street and Carmenita Road, Cerritos, California 90703, to the Olson Company for the purpose of developing an 18-unit affordable senior housing project, and authorizing execution of said first amendment

A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos approving the Engineer’s Report regarding the annual levy of assessments within the Los Coyotes Lighting and Landscaping District, declaring its intention to order and implement a reassessment beginning July 1, 2006 and setting a public hearing date of June 8, 2006
